reviews.author: Dr. Rajesh K.
reviews.text: Best unisex salon in MVP Colony without a doubt. Very clean and hygienic atmosphere near MG Cancer Hospital. Kiran gave me an exceptional haircut and beard grooming. Staff wears masks and uses sanitized blades every time.

reviews.author: Deepika Chintala
reviews.text: I booked my bridal makeover here with Ananya. She is truly magical! My HD makeup stayed flawless throughout the 6-hour ceremony in Vizag humidity. Everyone praised my look. Highly recommend J Studio Luxury Beauty Salon!

reviews.author: Manoj Kumar P.
reviews.text: They are authentic L'Oréal Professionnel partners. Got my hair keratin treatment done, results are so smooth and natural. Transparent pricing, no hidden charges. Parking right in front was very convenient.

reviews.author: Sneha Latha
reviews.text: The HydraFacial here is top class. My skin felt glowing and deeply cleansed for days. The ambience is quiet, luxurious, and the staff is very polite. Worth every rupee.

reviews.author: Kalyan Varma
reviews.text: Great stylists who actually listen to what you want. Rahul styled my hair perfectly. Just make sure you book in advance on weekends as it gets very busy.
